description: This Java class handles update commands for holiday entities in the Fineract system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface to process command objects and delegates the update operation to the 'HolidayWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated as a Spring service and is associated with the 'HOLIDAY' entity and 'UPDATE' action via custom annotations.

classes.name: UpdateHolidayCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for holiday entities, utilizing dependency injection for the service layer and implementing the command processing interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to update a holiday by delegating to the HolidayWritePlatformService.
